LanguageData.KR_LetterText: He watches every kill from the darkness, and your struggle amuses Him greatly. This boon is yours. Claim it — and try to stay alive.
LanguageData.KR_RewardResearchDesc: He sears knowledge straight into your scholars' minds. Instantly complete one available research project.
LanguageData.KR_RewardSkillDesc: He plucks the strings of nerve and muscle. Choose a pawn; one of their skills gains 3 levels.
LanguageData.KR_RewardItemDesc: He casts provisions from the void. Choose an item and a drop cell to receive a full stack.
LanguageData.KR_RewardBlessingDesc: By His blood: rebirth from a single drop, a butterfly from its cocoon. Choose a blessing: renewal for the whole colony, or reshaping one pawn's traits and genes.
LanguageData.KR_BlessingRegenDesc: All members regenerate 350 HP per day for 3 days: wounds close and missing limbs and organs regrow.
LanguageData.KR_BlessingTraitDesc: Add or remove one trait for a pawn; each use raises the next cost.
LanguageData.KR_BlessingGeneDesc: Add or remove one gene (germline or xenogene) for a pawn; each use raises the next cost.
LanguageData.KR_Claimed: The boon is granted. He is still watching. Keep Him entertained.
LanguageData.KR_NoPending: He has no boon for you yet. Slaughter is prayer.
LanguageData.KR_SettingEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, kills grant no progress and the main button is hidden — no need to remove the mod from your mod list.
LanguageData.KR_SettingInitialDesc: Kills required for the first reward tier.
LanguageData.KR_SettingFactorDesc: In exponential mode, each tier costs this factor times the previous one.
LanguageData.KR_SettingIncrementDesc: In linear mode, each tier costs this many more kills than the previous one.
LanguageData.KR_SettingModInitialCostDesc: Boons required for the first modification; each further modification costs more per the chosen curve.
LanguageData.KR_PickCell: Click a cell to deliver the goods
LanguageData.KR_ItemDelivered: The gift from the void has arrived.
LanguageData.KR_PawnUnavailable: That pawn is no longer available.
